Concrete Particular

A particular that is bounded to one spatial location at a time

Note

Differently from Schematic particulars, a concrete particular only occupies one place or location at a time: my copy of War and Peace occupies one slot in my bookcase right now; I can only occupy one place at a time; a unit of Toyota Corolla is in one place at a time; a particular performance of Beethoven's Symphony No 9 takes place in one and only one venue

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
